props.name: width
props.description:
The width, in dp, to report instead of the window's. Leave it out (or
`undefined`) and the real window width is reported, so the provider can sit
in place permanently and be switched on by a value.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Whether the panel is open. The accordion keeps its own open state: it
starts from this value, a press on the header toggles it, and it follows
the prop again whenever the prop changes. So it works as an initial state
(`expanded` alone) and as a controlled value (a parent that sets `expanded`
from `onClick`). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: icon
props.description:
The icon at the end of the header: a glyph name, or any node. It is drawn
as given; the default, a chevron, turns upside down while the panel is open.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called on every press of the header with the new state: `true` when it opens, `false` when it closes.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"outlined"` is a bordered panel on the surface, `"contained"` a filled
tonal one without a border. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: actions
props.description:
After the title: up to three action `IconButton`s per M3. Under a
navigator it defaults to `options.headerRight()`.

props.name: back
props.description: Truthy when a back destination exists (native-stack passes `{ title, href }`).

props.name: divider
props.description:
A hairline under the bar. Left out, it is drawn on the web when the bar
sits under a navigator and not otherwise.

props.name: elevated
props.description: The on-scroll state: `surfaceContainer` instead of `surface`.

props.name: isPinned
props.description: A pinned (always visible) drawer needs no menu button.

props.name: leading
props.description:
Before the title: typically a back or menu `IconButton`. Under a
navigator it defaults to a back button, or a menu button for a drawer.

props.name: navigation
props.description:
react-navigation's header contract, for a bar passed as a navigator's
`header`: `navigation.goBack` and `navigation.openDrawer` feed the leading
button. Structural, so any navigator's object fits; the library never
imports react-navigation.

props.name: options
props.description:
The screen's navigator options: `headerTitle` or `title` give the title,
`headerRight` the actions, and `headerLeft: null` or `hideMenuIcon` hides
the drawer's menu button.

props.name: paper
props.description:
Props of the `Paper` the bar is drawn on (`elevation`, `outline`, `glow`,
`style`), merged over the bar's own: `elevation` is `0`, or `2` when
`elevated`. `<AppBar paper={{ elevation: 3 }} />` lifts the bar to level 3.

props.name: route
props.description: The navigator's route: its `name` is the title when nothing else is.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Pads the top safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line under the title.

props.name: title
props.description:
The headline. A string is drawn in the variant's type style; any other
node is placed as is. Left out, it is read from `options` and `route`
(see `navigation`).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"small"` and `"center"` keep the title in the 64dp row; `"medium"` and
`"large"` move it to a second, larger line. Defaults to `"small"`.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height — `16 / 9`, `1`, `4 / 3`. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the text as it changes: typed, cleared, or filled in by a
picked option (its label; empty after a pick with `multiple`).

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. Free text is allowed — this is not a Select.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description:
Whether text that is not an option may stay in the field. Defaults to
`true`. With `false`, leaving the field puts back the chosen option's
label, or empties it when nothing is chosen (always empties it with
`multiple`, where the text is only a query).

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button once there is text. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Quiet time in ms before `onSearch`. Defaults to 300.

props.name: defaultOptions
props.description:
The suggestions offered while the field has fewer than `minChars`
characters — before the user has typed, or before a first search has
returned — instead of keeping the list closed. They are shown as given,
not filtered. From `minChars` on, the list is `options`. Leave out for
no list until the user types.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Omit to hide the list instead.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom matcher. Defaults to a case- and accent-insensitive substring test
over `label`, or to no filtering at all when `onSearch` is given (the
server already filtered).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"` within
it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field — for options still being fetched.

props.name: maxSuggestions
props.description: Caps the visible suggestions. Defaults to 8.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Characters required before suggestions appear. Defaults to 1.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Picks one option (the default). Set to `true` to pick several.

props.name: onSearch
props.description:
Called with the text after the user stops typing for `debounce` ms, once
it has `minChars` characters, and with `""` when the field is cleared.
Fetch the options there and pass them in `options`; use `loading`
meanwhile. Not called for the text an option fills in.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called on every pick with the option, and with `null` when the choice is cleared.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The chosen option, kept apart from the text being typed. Pass it (even as
`null`) to control the choice; editing the text away from its label, or
clearing the field, reports `null` through `onSelectedChange`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: name
props.description:
Initials are drawn from it when there is no `source`, and it is shown as a
tooltip on hover (web) or long press (native).

props.name: size
props.description: A size in pixels, or `"small"` (32), `"medium"` (40) or `"large"` (56). Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role of the badge. Defaults to `"error"`.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap shown as "max+" when count exceeds it.

props.name: position
props.description:
The corner of the parent the badge is pinned to, overlapping it slightly.
Left out, the badge is only absolutely placed and the parent (or `style`)
positions it.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Render the badge even when count is 0 (hidden by default).

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two actions, rendered right-aligned below the message.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Show a close (X) button; requires onDismiss.

props.name: active
props.description: Blinks while true; stays at full opacity while false. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: children
props.description: What blinks: a dot, a badge, a line of text.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds one half of a blink takes: the fade down to `minOpacity`, and again the fade back up. Defaults to 600.

props.name: minOpacity
props.description: The opacity at the dimmest point of a blink, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.2.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called by the close button, a tap on the scrim, a drag down past the threshold and Android back.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the sheet is open.

props.name: actions
props.description:
A row of buttons fixed at the bottom, below a divider, while the content
above it scrolls (named like `Dialog`'s `actions`).

props.name: maxHeightRatio
props.description: Max sheet height as a fraction of the window height.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Adds a close button at the end of the title row. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: background
props.description:
Background — a theme colour token (`"surfaceContainer"`) or any colour
string.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour — a theme colour token or any colour string.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between children, in px.

props.name: margin
props.description: Margin on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every edge, in px. One edge or one axis goes through `style`.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: style
props.description: Merged last, over the variant and every other prop.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout preset: direction, centring and filling the parent. The other props
and `style` are applied on top of it.
- `standard`: a plain column (default).
- `flex`: a row.
- `column-flex`: a column.
- `centered-flex`: a row, centred on both axes.
- `centered-column-flex`: a column, centred on both axes.
- `full-page-flex`: a row that fills the screen (`flex: 1`, minimum height 100%).
- `full-page-column-flex`: the same, as a column.
- `full-size-flex`: a row, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-column`: a column, 100% wide and 100% high.
- `full-size-centered-flex`: a row, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.
- `full-size-centered-column-flex`: a column, 100% x 100%, centred on both axes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children flow onto the next line (or column) instead of overflowing.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when exceeding this count.

props.name: badge
props.description:
A count shown after the label (a `Badge`): active filters, unread items.
Hidden at 0 or when left out.

props.name: busy
props.description:
Blocks presses and announces the button as busy, but — unlike `loading` —
keeps the label, the icon and the full-strength colours on screen.

props.name: color
density
props.description:
Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: about 36 px
instead of 48.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the parent width.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Icon side relative to the label.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label text, after the theme's type style.

props.name: type
props.description:
`"submit"` submits the enclosing `Form` when pressed, after `onClick`, on
every platform. A button outside a `Form` ignores it. Defaults to
`"button"`.

props.name: underlay
props.description:
Drawn behind the label across the whole surface, clipped to its shape:
a progress fill, a state animation. It receives no touches.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, or the selected values with `multiSelect`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: mode
props.description: Look of the unselected buttons; selected ones are filled. Defaults to `"tonal"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `"s"` (40dp).

props.name: type
props.description:
`"standard"` spaces the buttons apart; `"connected"` joins them into one
control (the successor of segmented buttons). Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the buttons sit on the row. M3 puts card actions on the right.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text — an unnamed image is invisible to a screen reader.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. M3 card covers default to 16:9.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Trailing slot — an `IconButton`, a `Menu` anchor, a `Chip`.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading slot — an `Avatar`, an `Icon`, a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: autoPlayInterval
props.description: Auto-advance interval in ms; 0 disables auto-play.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height; otherwise sized by the tallest page.

props.name: showArrows
props.description: Overlay prev/next arrow buttons.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the toggle to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state (e.g. "select all" with partial selection); overrides the checkmark.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives the new set of checked values after each toggle.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the checked options.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacks the options (`"column"`) or lays them in a wrapping line (`"row"`). Defaults to `"column"`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the group; it also turns the checkboxes and the label red.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each toggle to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the group; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description:
Overrides the role of a pressable chip (`"button"`). A chip that toggles
inside a group is a `"radio"` or a `"checkbox"`, and then reports
`selected` as checked.

props.name: border
props.description:
Corner shape: `"rounded"` (the default), `"squared"` for square corners,
`"circular"` for a pill.

props.name: color
props.description:
Colour role. `filled` takes the role's accent, `tonal` its container,
`outlined` draws the label and the outline in it. Left out, the chip keeps
the neutral secondary look. `toneFrom` wins over it.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report presses: a `"checkbox"` chip toggles, a `"radio"` one selects to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.description: "small" renders a compact 24px chip, "large" a 40px one.

props.name: toneFrom
props.description:
Tints a `"filled"` or `"tonal"` chip from a `#RRGGBB` colour or from any
text (the same text always gives the same colour), readable in light and dark.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value (or `null`), or the selected values with `multiple`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the group for assistive tech.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Filter chips: any number selected. Defaults to `false` (one at most).

props.name: required
props.description: Single select only: the selected chip cannot be deselected.

props.name: variant
props.description: Chip look. Defaults to `"outlined"`, the M3 filter chip.

props.name: wrap
props.description: `true` wraps onto more lines; `false` scrolls sideways. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the content is expanded.

props.name: animateOpacity
props.description: Fades the content along with the height change. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height kept visible while collapsed — a peek/teaser. Defaults to 0.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition length in ms. Defaults to 200.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Skips unmounting the children while collapsed. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height; follows `ThemeProvider`'s `density` unless set here.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown centered when data is empty and not loading.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Drawn instead of `emptyMessage` when data is empty and not loading: an illustration, a call to action.

props.name: rowStyle
props.type: ViewStyle | ((row: any, index: number) => ViewStyle | undefined)
props.description: One style for every row, or a function of the row (to dim or highlight one).

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description:
Which surface the dialog opens on, `"picker"` or typed `"keyboard"` entry.
There is no toggle between the two in the dialog, so this is the only way
to get typed entry there. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: fieldVariant
props.description:
The look of the field's box, as `variant` on `Input`: `"outlined"` is a
bordered box on the surface, `"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border
only while the picker is open, the typed text has focus, or there is an
`error`. Named apart from `variant`, which already chooses between the
field and the inline picker. Does nothing for `variant="static"`, which has
no field. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "OK", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Web only, `variant="default"` only: whether the picker opens docked to its
field or as a dialog. Decided each time it opens. Native always opens the
dialog. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: showToday
props.description:
Offers a "Today" button next to the month arrows. Default `true`. Only a
single-date calendar has one, and it is disabled while today is outside
`validRange` or excluded by `isDateDisabled`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: slotStyles
props.description:
Style overrides for the parts of the dialog, merged after its own styles;

props.name: actions
props.description:
Trailing action row. Replaces the single `closeText` button. In a

props.description:

props.description:
Wraps the body and the `actions` in a `Form`, so a `Button

props.description:
The M3 full-screen dialog, for a form on a compact window: it fills the
window, with a close button, the title and `actions` in a header row and

props.description:

window (`"60%"`). The body scrolls when the content is taller. The card

backdrop, Escape (web) and Android back. Without it the dialog has no
way to close itself, so `visible` stays up to the app.

props.description: Called when the `form` is submitted. Only used with `form`.

props.description: Scrolls the body when the content is taller than the dialog.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: iconMode
props.description:
`animated` only. `static` keeps the icon put and slides the label out
beside it; `dynamic` lets the icon travel with the label as the pill grows.

props.name: label
props.description:
The text of `extended` and `animated`, and the accessible name of every
variant. Without it those two variants fall back to the icon alone.

props.name: size
props.description: Defaults to `"medium"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Defaults to `"icon"`.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called when the form is submitted: a `Button type="submit"` inside it is
pressed, or (on the web) Enter is pressed in one of its fields.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the control. Its presence marks the group invalid.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the control; hidden while `error` is set.

props.name: autoSize
props.description:
Sizes the children of a container that have no `size` of their own, so
they do not need one each. `true` is a card per row on a phone, two from
`sm` and three from `md` (`{ xs: 12, sm: 6, md: 4 }`, for 12 columns); a
size gives every child that size; a function is called with the index and
the element of each child (its `key` is `child.key`) and returns its size:
`(index, child) => child.key === "notes" ? { xs: 12 } : { xs: 12, md: 6 }`.
A child that is not a `Grid` is put in an item of the size it gets.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns in a row of this container; an item's `size` counts in them.

props.name: container
props.description:
Makes this grid lay its children out in rows of `columns` columns. The
grid items go inside it, each with its own `size`. A container inside
another container is also an item of it, and takes a `size` too.

props.name: size
props.description:
An item's width in the container's row: a number of columns (1 to
`columns`), `"grow"` to share the rest of the row, `"auto"` to size to its
content, or an object with one of those for each breakpoint
(`{ xs: 12, md: 6 }`). A breakpoint without a value takes the next smaller
one that has; with none, the item is `"auto"`. Without `size` an item is
`"auto"`, unless the container has `autoSize`.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Gap between the items of a container: a number of px, a spacing token name
(`"m"`), or `{ row, column }` of those for the two axes.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Whether a container moves items that do not fit onto the next row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the text to match a disabled field.

props.name: padding
props.description: `none` removes the 16px gutter that aligns the text with the field body.

props.name: type
props.description: `error` switches to the error role and shows the alert glyph.

props.name: visible
props.description: Fades the text out instead of unmounting it, so the field doesn't jump.

props.name: flipForRTL
props.description: Mirror the glyph when the layout direction is RTL (arrows, chevrons).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Required: an icon alone carries no accessible name.

props.name: badge
props.description: A count on the top-right corner (a `Badge`). Hidden at 0 or when left out.

props.name: color
props.description:
Colour role of the button. Left out, it keeps the neutral M3 look
(`onSurfaceVariant`, `primary` once selected).

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the press (a toggle when `selected` is set) to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: selected
props.description: Renders the M3 "selected" container of a toggle icon button.

props.name: title
props.description:
A tooltip with this text: on hover or focus on the web, on long press on
native. It is a label for sighted users; `accessibilityLabel` stays the
accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 icon-button container styles. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: src
props.description: The address of the page to embed.

props.name: title
props.description: The frame's accessible name: what the embedded page is. Required, as a frame without one is announced as nothing.

props.name: allow
props.description: The `allow` attribute: the features the page may use (`"fullscreen; clipboard-write"`).

props.name: fallback
props.description: Drawn on iOS and Android instead of the page. Defaults to an icon and a short notice.

props.name: height
props.description: Defaults to 300.

props.name: loading
props.description: `"lazy"` loads the page when the frame comes near the viewport. Defaults to `"lazy"`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called when the frame reports an error loading. Browsers rarely do for a page that fails to load.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called when the page has loaded.

props.name: referrerPolicy
props.description: The `referrerpolicy` attribute.

props.name: sandbox
props.description:
The `sandbox` attribute. `""` applies every restriction; a list of tokens
(`"allow-scripts allow-same-origin"`) lifts the ones named. Left out, the
page is not sandboxed.

props.name: style
props.description: Style of the box the frame fills: radius, border, margin, flex.

props.name: width
props.description: Defaults to the full width of the parent.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Alternative text. Required — an image with no accessible name is invisible
to screen readers.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description: Shown when loading fails and there is no `fallbackSource`.

props.name: fallbackSource
props.description: Swapped in when `source` fails to load.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. Use instead of `height` for fluid layouts.

props.name: showLoader
props.description: Renders a pulsing skeleton until the image resolves. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every edit (for `type="number"`, already cleaned).

props.name: allUpperCase
props.description: Capitalises what is typed (codes, plates, tax ids). Not for `type="number"`.

props.name: decimalSeparator
props.description:
The decimal mark a `type="number"` field types and shows: `","` for a user
who writes 12,50. `value` and `onChange` stay in the plain form
("12.50"), so the app parses nothing; a typed "." is then ignored, as a
thousands mark. Defaults to `"."`.

props.name: density
props.description: Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: a 40 px field instead of 56, 14 px text, less space below.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the field to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width so an empty field stays usable. Defaults to
`true`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the text within it. Independent of `variant`. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Overrides the height `density` gives (56, or 40 when dense).

props.name: multiline
props.description: Lets the text wrap over several lines; see `rows`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the field loses focus.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the field gains focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: reserveHelperText
props.description:
Keeps the line under the field even with no helper or error text, so a
message appearing does not push the next field down. Default false.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines of a `multiline` field. Ignored otherwise. Defaults to 4.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: allowedSchemes
props.description:
URL schemes `href` may use. A link whose `href` came from data (a user's
website, a CMS field) must not be able to open `javascript:`, `intent:` or
another app's deep link. Add your own app's scheme here to deep-link.
Defaults to `["http", "https", "mailto", "tel"]`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Opened with `Linking.openURL`. Ignored when `onPress` is given, and when
its scheme is not in `allowedSchemes` — then the link does nothing.

props.name: showExternalIcon
props.description: Appends an external-link icon. Defaults to `true` when `href` is remote.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline behaviour. Defaults to `"hover"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: M3 typography variant for the label. Defaults to `"bodyMedium"`.

props.name: primaryText
props.description: The first line. Text is drawn in the theme's type; any other node is drawn as given.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing slot: a value, a Switch, an `IconButton`, a chevron.

props.name: dimmed
props.description: Faded, for a row that is removed or inactive. Still pressable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the row and stops it being pressed. The `action` is not disabled with it: it is a control of its own.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading slot: a glyph name, or any node (an Avatar, a Checkbox).

props.name: indicatorColor
props.description: A coloured bar on the left edge, for a status or a priority.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Called when the row is pressed. Giving it makes the row a button. With an
`action` as well, only the icon and the texts are the button: the action is
a control of its own beside it, so a button never sits inside a button.

props.name: primaryTextStyle
props.description: Merged after the type of `primaryText`; applies when it is text, a node styles itself.

props.name: secondaryText
props.description: Second line below `primaryText`. Text or any node, like `primaryText`.

props.name: secondaryTextStyle
props.description: Merged after the type of `secondaryText`; applies when it is text, a node styles itself.

props.name: trailingWidth
props.description: Fixes the width of the `action` slot and right-aligns it, so a column of rows lines its actions up.

props.name: divider
props.description: Rule below the section, for a settings screen of stacked groups.

props.name: title
props.description: Group label rendered above the rows as a heading.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element the menu opens from.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on a press outside the menu, on Android back, and after an item is clicked when `closeOnSelect` is on.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the menu is open.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Where the menu sits against its anchor: `vertical` is `"bottom"` (below
it), `"top"` (above it) or `"center"` (centred on it); `horizontal` lines
up the `"left"` edges, the `"right"` edges or the `"center"`s. It flips or
slides to stay on screen. Defaults to `{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "left" }`.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu automatically after an item is clicked. Default true.

props.name: dividers
props.description: Draws a divider between every pair of items, on top of any `dividerAbove`. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the clicked item, after the item's own `onClick`.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The `id`s of the items to draw as selected: a tinted row with a check
mark, and `accessibilityState.selected` set on it. Items are not marked
until you pass it, even as `[]`.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` of the current destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Destinations, three to five per M3.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the `id` of the pressed destination.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: "always" shows every label, "selected" only the active one.

props.name: children
props.description:
`DrawerSection`s and/or `DrawerItem`s, or any content when the drawer is a
side sheet (a form, filters, details).

props.name: actions
props.description: A row of buttons at the bottom, below a divider.

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
Icons only, 72 wide: labels, badges, titles and sub-items are hidden (an
item without an icon shows its first letter). Defaults to `false`.

props.name: elevation
props.description:
The level of the surface, 0 to 5: the tone it is painted in and, on iOS
and Android, its shadow. Defaults to `0` when static and `1` when
swipeable.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned below the scrolling items.

props.name: header
props.description: Pinned above the scrolling items: a logo, a site picker.

props.name: height
props.description: Top and bottom: the largest height, defaults to 360.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Shows a back button before the title, for a drawer with sub-pages.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Called by the close button, and by a swipeable drawer's scrim, closing
drag, Android back and Escape (web).

props.name: position
props.description:
The window edge it is attached to: `"left"` and `"right"` are columns of
`width`, `"top"` and `"bottom"` span the full width and are as tall as
their content, up to `height`. The edges are physical, not mirrored in
right-to-left layouts. Defaults to `"left"`.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Adds a close button to the header row, which calls `onClose`. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: title
props.description:
Headline at the top of the drawer. With a close button, a back button or
`actions` it is the title of a header row instead, in a larger type.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"static"` is a permanent panel in the layout, beside the content, with no
scrim. `"swipeable"` slides over the content on a scrim, and a drag toward
its edge, the scrim, Android back and Escape (web) close it.
Defaults to `"static"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Swipeable only: whether the drawer is open.

props.name: width
props.description: Left and right: defaults to 360 (M3), capped at the window width when swipeable.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` of the current destination.

props.name: items
props.description: Destinations, same shape as `NavBar`'s. Three to seven per M3.

props.name: alignment
props.description: Where the destinations sit vertically. Defaults to `"top"`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned to the bottom of the rail.

props.name: header
props.description: Above the destinations: typically a menu `IconButton` and/or a `FAB`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description:
`"always"` labels every destination, `"selected"` only the active one,
`"none"` none (the label is still the accessible name). Defaults to `"always"`.

props.name: activePage
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the page the user picked: a page button, an arrow or `pageSelect`.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour role of the selected page. Defaults to `"primary"`.

props.name: pageSelect
props.description:
Adds a small select after the pager that jumps to any page: it shows the
active page, and opens a list of pages under a search field. Typing digits
narrows the list to the pages that contain them, which keeps it usable with
thousands of pages; Enter picks the first match.

props.name: showFirstLast
props.description: Show jump-to-first / jump-to-last arrows.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the buttons and their type: 32, 40 or 48 px. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"rounded"` draws the buttons as rounded squares, `"circular"` as circles. Defaults to `"rounded"`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole code, not the single cell, on every edit.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Cell edge length. Defaults to 48.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the cells; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells. Defaults to 6.

props.name: mask
props.description: Renders dots instead of characters.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired once the last cell is filled.

props.name: type
props.description: Restricts the accepted characters. Defaults to `"numeric"`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Cell style: `"outlined"` draws each cell as a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` as a tinted box that shows its border only while focused or in
error. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: anchor
props.description: The element the popover opens from. It stays in the layout; the popover floats over the window.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on a press outside the popover and on Android back.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the popover is open.

props.name: anchorPosition
props.description:
Where the popover sits against its anchor: `vertical` is `"bottom"`
(below it), `"top"` (above it) or `"center"` (centred on it);
`horizontal` lines up the `"left"` edges, the `"right"` edges or the
`"center"`s. Whatever it asks, the popover flips or slides to stay on
screen. Defaults to `{ vertical: "bottom", horizontal: "left" }`.

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.description: Gives the popover the anchor's width instead of sizing it to its content.

props.name: color
props.description: Indicator colour. Defaults to `primary`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides it from assistive tech when something else announces the progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Indeterminate only: one revolution, in ms.

props.name: label
props.description:
Text, a number or any node drawn with the ring, at `labelPosition`. Text
is drawn in the theme's type, scaled to the ring when it is inside; a node
as given.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
Where `label` goes: `"center"` inside the ring, or `"top"`, `"bottom"`,
`"left"` or `"right"` of it. Defaults to `"center"` for a ring with a
`progress` and to `"right"` for a spinner, which is too small to hold a label.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion from 0 to 1. Set, the ring fills to it over a track; unset,
the indicator spins (indeterminate).

props.name: trackColor
props.description:
The ring under the indicator. `true` draws it in the indicator's colour at
a low opacity, a string draws it in that colour, `false` draws none. Left
out, a ring with a `progress` has its usual track (`secondaryContainer`)
and a spinner has none.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Hide the bar from assistive technology, for when the component around it
already announces the progress — a bar inside a button is not a second
control to land on.

props.name: height
props.description:
Bar thickness. A percentage fills the parent — a progress surface. Defaults
to 4, and to 20 when the label is `"inside"`, which has to fit on the bar.

props.name: label
props.description:
Text, a number or any node drawn with the bar, at `labelPosition`. Text is
drawn in the theme's type; a node as given.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description:
Where `label` goes: above (`"top-left"`, `"top-center"`, `"top-right"`) or
below (`"bottom-*"`) the bar, aligned as named, beside it (`"left"`,
`"right"`), or `"inside"`, centred on the bar. Inside, text is drawn in two
colours, over the filled part and over the track, so it reads on both; that
suits a bar with a `progress`, on an indeterminate one the text is only
legible over the track. Defaults to `"right"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the whole component, label included. Defaults to the full width of the parent.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name while idle. Falls back to the label.

props.name: children
props.description: The idle label. Also the loading label unless `loadingLabel` is set.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of each progress step's transition, in ms.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Label once the task failed. The button stays pressable, to retry.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon while idle and loading.

props.name: indicator
props.description:
How progress is drawn inside the surface: `fill` sweeps a darker (or, in
the dark scheme, lighter) tone of the button across it; `bar` runs a 4dp
line along its bottom edge.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label: font family, size, weight.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Label while loading, e.g. "Calculating route…".

props.name: onClick
props.description: Fires in every status but `loading`, where the button is busy.

props.name: onSuccessEnd
props.description: Called `successDuration` ms after the button turned to success.

props.name: progress
props.description:
Completion while `status` is `"loading"`, from 0 to 1. Leave it undefined
when the task cannot say how far along it is, for an indeterminate sweep.

props.name: progressColor
props.description: Colour of the fill or the bar. Derived from the button's colours if unset.

props.name: status
props.description:
Which moment of the task to show. Controlled: the button never moves
itself from one status to the next — the caller does, as the task reports.

props.name: style
props.description: Applied to the surface: corner radius, padding, width.

props.name: successDuration
props.description:
How long the success status holds before `onSuccessEnd` fires, in ms.
`0` keeps it until the caller changes `status`.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Label once the task succeeded.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Colour behind the bar, and behind the fill on outlined and text.

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report the selection to `ThemeProvider`'s `onInteractionFeedback` (haptics).
Defaults to true.

props.name: value
props.description: Current rating; fractions are drawn as a partly filled icon (e.g. 3.5).

props.name: icon
props.description:
The filled glyph. Its `-outline` variant draws the empty state, so it has
to be one that has one (`"heart"` does, `"star"` does). Defaults to `"star"`.

props.name: interval
props.description:
The step of the rating: `1` rates whole icons, `0.5` lets the pointer pick
either half of an icon. Defaults to `1`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Interactive when provided.

props.name: required
props.description:
The rating cannot be cleared: tapping the current value keeps it. Without
it, tapping the current value resets the rating to 0.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the text as it changes. With `debounceTime` it waits until the
user has stopped typing; submitting or clearing reports at once.

props.name: debounceTime
props.description:
Milliseconds the user must stop typing before `onChange` fires. The field
itself always updates at once; a `value` set from outside replaces the
text and drops a pending `onChange`. Defaults to 0: every keystroke.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph at the start of the bar. Defaults to `"magnify"`.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: showLoading
props.description:
Tells the bar a search is running: a progress indicator takes the place of
the clear button. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Called with the picked option's `value`, or with `null` when a
`nullable` select is cleared. Not called with `multiple`: see
`toggleOptions`.

props.name: value
props.description: The `value` of the selected option; `null` for none. Ignored with `multiple`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the option list already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: density
props.description: Control height. `"dense"` is for desktop forms and tables: a 40 px field instead of 52, 14 px text, less space below.

props.name: disabledOptions
props.description:
Options that stay visible but cannot be picked, announced as disabled:
the `value`s to disable, or a pattern tested against each `String(value)`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown in the open list when `options` is empty. Defaults to `"No options"`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:
Stretches the select to its container's width. `false` shrinks it to its
content, with a minimum width. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description:
Where the label is drawn: `"outside"` above the box, or `"inside"`, small,
above the value. Independent of `variant`; with chips showing it stays
above the box. Defaults to `"outside"`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Picks several options at once; the list stays open. Set `selectedValues` and `toggleOptions` too.

props.name: nullable
props.description:
Lets the user go back to no selection: a clear button shows in the field
while an option is selected, and pressing the selected option again
deselects it. Both call `onChange(null)`. Ignored with `multiple`, where
every option can already be unchecked. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: selectedValues
props.description: With `multiple`: the `value`s of the selected options.

props.name: showAsChips
props.description: With `multiple`, shows the selection as removable chips in the field.

props.name: toggleOptions
props.description: With `multiple`: called with the new array of selected `value`s after each toggle.

props.name: variant
props.description:
The look of the box: `"outlined"` is a bordered box on the surface,
`"filled"` a tinted box (like `PinInput`'s) that shows its border only
while focused or in error. Where the label sits is `labelPlacement`'s
business, not the variant's. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: animate
props.description: false renders a static placeholder (no pulse).

props.name: duration
props.description: Pulse animation duration for a full cycle (ms).

props.name: feedback
props.description:
Report each step the thumb crosses to `ThemeProvider`'s
`onInteractionFeedback` (haptics), as a selection. Only with a `step`: a
continuous slider would report every pixel. Defaults to true.

props.name: marks
props.description: Draw a tick at every step (requires step > 0).

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the snackbar is on screen.

props.name: action
props.description: A text button after the message. Clicking it runs `onClick`, then dismisses the snackbar.

props.name: duration
props.description:
Auto-hide delay in ms; `0` keeps it up. Defaults to 4000. Not used when
`onClose` is set.

props.name: icon
props.description: Overrides the icon implied by `severity`.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Shows a close icon button and keeps the snackbar up until the user
closes it: `duration` is not used, and the timeout never calls
`onDismiss`.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description:
Called when the snackbar times out (after `duration`) or its `action` is
clicked. Not called when `onClose` is set: the snackbar then stays up
until the user closes it.

props.name: position
props.description: Which edge and corner it sits in, clear of the safe-area insets. Defaults to `"bottom-center"`.

props.name: severity
props.description:
What the message is about: `"success"` is green, `"info"` blue,
`"warning"` amber and `"error"` red, with a matching icon. Left out, the
snackbar is the neutral inverse surface, with no icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"contained"` fills it with the severity's colours; `"outlined"` draws it on the surface with a severity-coloured outline, label and icon. Defaults to `"contained"`.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which axis `size` applies to. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Fixed size along the parent's axis. Omit to absorb the leftover space.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the action stack already expanded. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: children
props.description: The primary action's label.

props.name: items
props.description: The related actions the trailing half opens.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The primary action.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Leading icon of the primary action.

props.name: menuAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trailing half. Defaults to `"More options"`.

props.name: mode
props.description: Defaults to `"filled"`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacking axis. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: dividers
props.description:
Puts a divider between the children. `true` draws a hairline, vertical in
a horizontal stack; a node is used as the divider instead. Empty children
(`null`, `false`) get none, and the spacing applies on both sides of it.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description:
Space between children — a spacing token name (`"m"`), a number of px, or
a string holding one (`"12"`).

props.name: label
props.description: What the number measures.

props.name: value
props.description: The number itself; pre-formatted by the caller.

props.name: delta
props.description: Signed change shown next to an up/down arrow, e.g. `"12.5%"`.

props.name: direction
props.description:
`"column"` stacks the label over the value. `"row"` puts them on one line,
the value after the label, with the delta right behind the value. Defaults
to `"column"`.

props.name: helpText
props.description: Extra context under the value.

props.name: trend
props.description: Direction of `delta`. Drives the arrow, and the colour unless `trendColor` is set.

props.name: trendColor
props.description:
The colour of the arrow and `delta`: a theme colour token (a role such as
`"success"` or `"error"`, or `"onSurfaceVariant"`, ...) or any colour string.
Left out, `"up"` is `success`, `"down"` is `error` and `"flat"` neutral. For a
metric where down is good, pass the colour yourself.

props.name: caption
props.description: The label: "Phone", "Due date". Text, or any node.

props.name: captionColor
props.description:
A theme colour token (`"primary"`, `"onSurfaceVariant"`, ...) or any colour
string. Defaults to `onSurfaceVariant`.

props.name: direction
props.description: `"column"` stacks the caption over the value, `"row"` puts them side by side.

props.name: enableCopy
props.description:
Shows a small copy button after the value, for a text or number value (a
node has nothing to copy). On web it writes the value to the clipboard
(`navigator.clipboard`); the library has no clipboard dependency, so on
native the button is shown only with an `onCopy` that does the copying.
The button's icon changes to a check for a moment, and "Copied" is
announced, once the value is copied.

props.name: fallback
props.description:
Drawn when `value` is empty (`null`, `undefined`, `""` or `false`; `0` is a
value). Defaults to `"N/A"`.

props.name: flex
props.description: Flex of the pair in its parent.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the caption and the value, in px. Defaults to 4.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the pair.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description: Lines the value may use before it is cut with an ellipsis; `0` is no limit. Defaults to 1.

props.name: omitCaption
props.description: Draws no caption at all, instead of an empty line.

props.name: onCopy
props.description:
Called with the value as text when the copy button is pressed. On native
it is where the app copies it (`Clipboard.setStringAsync` from
`expo-clipboard`); on web it is called after the clipboard write succeeded.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding around the pair, in px.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Puts the value before the caption.

props.name: showTooltip
props.description:
Wraps a text or number value in a `Tooltip` with the value as its content:
the value in full, for when `numberOfLines` cuts it.

props.name: style
props.description: For anything the props above do not cover.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Text and numbers are drawn in the theme's type; any other node as given.

props.name: valueColor
props.description:
A theme colour token (`"primary"`, `"error"`, ...) or any colour string.
Defaults to `onSurface`.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the pair.

props.name: toneFrom
props.description:
Tints the badge from a `#RRGGBB` colour or from any text instead of from
`type`, which still picks the default icon.

props.name: activeStep
props.description: Position of the current step. Those before it are completed.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order; a string is a step with just a label.

props.name: direction
props.description:

`"column"` stacks them, the label beside each circle. Defaults to `"row"`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called with the pressed step's position. Makes the steps pressable.

props.name: onChange

props.name: activeKey
props.description: The active tab by its `key`, for tabs that come and go (by role, by flag).

props.name: activeTab
props.description: The active tab by position. Ignored when `activeKey` is given. Defaults to 0.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour role of the indicator and of the selected tab. Defaults to `"primary"`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description:

between the tabs. `false` sizes each tab to its label, and the bar scrolls
horizontally when they do not fit. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: height
props.description: Overrides the height of the bar: a number of dp, or a percentage.

props.name: showBorders
props.description:
Draws dividers between the tabs and, in the `"rounded"` variant, an outline
around the track. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: size
props.description: The height and the type of the tabs. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"standard"` is a bar with an underline under the active tab. `"rounded"`
is a pill-shaped active tab on a rounded track. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: width
props.description: Overrides the width of the bar: a number of dp, or a percentage.

props.name: children

rows out yourself. Ignored when `columns` is given.

props.name: columns

itself. When they add up to more than `width` the table scrolls sideways.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows, as `{ [column id]: cell }`. Data driven only.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown under the header when `data` is empty. Defaults to `"No data"`.

props.name: height
props.description:

stays in place; without it the table is as tall as its rows.

props.name: hover
props.description: Highlights the row under the pointer, on web; a row with `onClick` also highlights while pressed.

props.name: onClick

makes the rows pressable, with the button role.

props.name: rowsPerPage
props.description:

under the table (hidden while there is no data); the page goes back to the
first when `rowsPerPage` or the number of rows changes. Left out, every row
is drawn in one page.

props.name: selected
props.description:
The row index, or indexes, to draw as selected. An index is a position in
`data`, not in the page shown. The row is marked selected for assistive
technology too.

props.name: tableTitle
props.description: A heading drawn above the header row; also the table's accessible name.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the table. Without it the table fills its container.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType

There is no toggle between the two in the dialog, so this is the only way
to get typed entry there. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: fieldVariant
props.description:
The look of the field's box, as `variant` on `Input`: `"outlined"` is a
bordered box on the surface, `"filled"` a tinted box that shows its border
only while the picker is open, the typed text has focus, or there is an
`error`. Named apart from `variant`, which already chooses between the
field and the inline picker. Does nothing for `variant="static"`, which has
no field. Defaults to `"outlined"`.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "OK", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: presentation
props.description:
Web only, `variant="default"` only: whether the picker opens docked to its
field or as a dialog. Decided each time it opens. Native always opens the
dialog. Defaults to `"auto"`.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: showToday
props.description:
Offers a "Today" button next to the month arrows. Default `true`. Only a
single-date calendar has one, and it is disabled while today is outside
`validRange` or excluded by `isDateDisabled`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"default"` shows a field that opens the picker in a popover (web) or a
dialog; dismiss it by tapping outside, with the back gesture or with Escape.
`"static"` draws the picker inline in the page instead: no field, no popup,
no OK, and every selection calls `onChange` at once with the live value.
Of the field props only `disabled` and `style` apply to a static picker, and
it always shows the calendar and the clock, never typed entry.
